entities.name: Kazumi Saeki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kazumi Saeki  is a Japanese novelist from Sendai in Miyagi prefecture. Kazumi is his pen name, adopted because of his fondness for Van Gogh's paintings of wheat fields.
